# Delivery transport fixture

`delivery-proof-usaf-pd.jpg` is a 1200 × 755, 385,875-byte JPEG rendered by the existing LensLabs C++ engine from the unchanged `../photos/basketball-action-usaf-pd.jpg` fixture. It supplies real small JPEG bytes to isolated delivery transport/integrity tests. It is deliberately outside the three-original photographic benchmark directory.

The source is an official U.S. Air Force photograph by Technical Sgt. Dawn M. Price, public domain in the United States. See the source fixture's README for attribution and links. No endorsement by the depicted people or military is implied. No user media is used.

Generation: `native/build/lenslabs-native render tests/fixtures/photos/basketball-action-usaf-pd.jpg <new-output-path> --edge 1200`. The original was not overwritten. This derivative is not an additional independent source photograph or a culling accuracy fixture.
